question: Who holds the record for winning the overall maximum National Film Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Satyajit Ray**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The record for winning the overall maximum National Film Awards is held by **Satyajit Ray**.
 
• He **won a total of 32 National Film Awards in various categories,** making him one of the most celebrated filmmakers in Indian cinema.
 
• His films have been recognized for their artistic and technical excellence.
 
• He worked across various genres, including drama, fantasy, and thrillers. His films, such as **"Charulata,"** **"Shatranj Ke Khilari,"** and **"Ghare-Baire,"** are notable for their depth and cinematic craftsmanship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

__
 
• The National Film Awards is the most prominent film award ceremony in India.

 
 
• The National Film Awards, established in 1954, have been administered since 1973 by the Directorate of Film Festivals, Government of India, along with the International Film Festival of India and Indian Panorama.
 
• The event is organized by the Directorate of Film Festivals, which comes under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting__.​
